summary: Mint Inc Ltd (issuer) filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a definitive joint venture agreement (JV) between its wholly-owned subsidiary, Aspiration X Limited, and Rice Robotics Holdings Limited to form Rice Robotics AGI Holding Limited. Aspiration X (or its nominee) will own 87.5%, Rice Robotics 12.5%. Aspiration X will contribute HK$15 million in funding plus human resources and R&D; Rice Robotics will contribute three companies, technology, IP, and client relationships. The JV will focus on AI companion robots. This is a business combination structure, not an acquisition or spin-off.
